messages:
maria_chen: Observed two users who should have been removed by SCIM deprovisioning still have access to the Prod Console. Noted during compliance audit. :warning:

ravi_s: Which group were they in? any recent role changes?

maria_chen: They belonged to 'contractors/prod-readers', their employee records were marked terminated in our HR system yesterday at 14:02. SCIM logs show group removal events queued but no success for those two user ids.

jonathan_k: Paging sec_oncall — @sec_oncall can you check the scim-sync job health? last run and error rate?

sec_bot: scim-sync job status: last_run=2026-03-19T22:14:05Z, duration=54s, errors=2, queue_depth=0. Recent error: 502 from idp.example-corp.com. See /ops/jobs/scim-sync-2026-03-19.log

ravi_s: Attach logs? curious if retry backoff dropped them. Also check 'group_sync_cursor' and 'last_modified' fields in payloads.

maria_chen: Pasted snippet from scim-sync log:
```
2026-03-19T22:14:05Z INFO processing change: user=U-2389 action=remove_group group=contractors/prod-readers
2026-03-19T22:14:05Z ERROR idp response=502 for change U-2389 retry=1
2026-03-19T22:14:06Z INFO processed change: user=U-2389 status=queued_for_retry
```

olivia_pm: Could be transient IDP outage; why didn't our retry succeed later? We have 3 retries by default.

jonathan_k: I pulled audit-logs for the prod console: two distinct user sessions after 2026-03-19T23:00Z. The user_ids match the terminated accounts. We need to revoke sessions asap and confirm KMS/key access isn't affected.

teresa_l: Quick mitigation: revoke active sessions and clear remote access tokens for those users. I can execute revoke via admin panel, but need approval from @maria_chen.

maria_chen: Approve, please revoke and add temporary ACL to block 'prod-console' for 'contractors/*' until root cause fixed. :thumbsup: \n
ravi_s: Adding root cause hypotheses: a) idp transient 502 causing partial queue retention b) cursor advancement on success-only causing skipped retries c) permission drift from manual role change. Will triage.

jonathan_k: For next steps: 1) revoke sessions (done by teresa) 2) force re-run of scim-sync for yesterday's window with --reconcile flag 3) patch scim-sync to persist retry state and surface failed items on dashboard 4) add audit alert for 'terminated user logs in' events.

sec_bot: ACTIONS created: sec-1234 (revoke_sessions), sec-1235 (rerun_scim_reconcile), sec-1236 (patch_retry-persistence), sec-1237 (audit-alert). Assigned to teresa_l, ravi_s, jonathan_k, maria_chen respectively. ETA 24h for mitigation work.

teresa_l: Revoke completed at 1772012600. Verified sessions terminated and tokens revoked. :white_check_mark: 

maria_chen: Thanks. Ravi — can you run a dry reconciliation and attach the diff? Need confirmation that no other terminated users were left behind.

ravi_s: Running reconcile now, will post results in thread when done. :eyes:
